A warm, restrained return to the familiar public office counter after successful local work, at midday. NO raster text, letters, balloons, stamps with writing, arrows or additional inset panels.

Image2 is the actual familiar office counter/archive and Maret/Sera/Aren cast; use this warm inhabited architecture, not the pictured earlier receipt action. Image3 supplies current Aren/Sera costumes and gray bag after the test bundle was removed. Rusk in image3 does NOT come to the office. Only Maret, Sera and Aren appear here.
TOP29: Medium view across the polished dark wooden public counter. Maret stands behind her current register. Sera, auburn bob and burgundy coat, places ONE plain repair report with a couple of simple nonlettered retained-part sketches beside that register; her own dark brown/burgundy ledger remains with her. The physical old hood/tools stay at the works, not on this office counter. Aren stands alongside with his familiar gray satchel CLOSED and EMPTY on the same brown padded two-shoulder-strap/hip-belt harness. The old narrow gray strap remains rolled/tied at the bag side. The original YELLOW petition folder is visibly archived in Maret's wooden document tray behind her side of the counter; nobody passes it to Aren. Faces convey tired satisfaction and Maret's serious attention. The background public queue and tall windows suggest inhabited midday office work.
BOTTOM30: Closer human exchange with Maret's concentrated face and Aren's small dawning smile clearly visible. Maret holds/reads ONE new plain white office reply sheet beside the open current-address register, letting Aren hear the substantive decision. This is the first real reply, not another intake receipt. Sera watches quietly with her ledger. Yellow petition folder remains in the archive tray. No envelope or blue seal yet; those are prepared next panel. No documents inside Aren's bag yet. Do not make the reply a yellow folder, certificate trophy, black offer or interface window.
Aren invariants both tiers: youthful tousled black hair, cropped white jacket over black high-neck shirt, black trousers/gloves, same brown padded harness with hip belt, one brass rectangular badge on red waist cord. Old skin hole only at anatomical LEFT elbow and old ragged jacket hem. RIGHT sleeve intact. Exactly ONE fully sheathed sword at anatomical RIGHT hip, naturally hidden on the far side if camera requires; never put an extra scabbard on the near LEFT hip. No cyan line, glow, weapon in hands or new badge/rank. Bag on his BACK in these two panels, not simultaneously on the counter. Do not add ballast, outgoing packet, tools or the yellow folder to it.
Keep believable hand-to-paper contacts, relaxed supported standing positions and warm personal faces. Calm broad wood/cloth/stone shapes, selective meaningful seams and brass details, rich depth without all-over scratches. Leave unobtrusive open space above the speakers for later editable lettering, but generate no lettering or white balloons.
